test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are INCORRECT related to excretion in human being?

(i) In human beings, kidney is located in the thoracic region.

(ii) Urine is stored in the urinary bladder.

(iii) CO₂ is removed from the blood into the lungs.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only (i)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kidneys in human beings are located in the abdominal region, specifically between the levels of the last thoracic and third lumbar vertebrae, not in the thoracic region.
 
• Urine produced by the kidneys is stored in the urinary bladder until it is excreted from the body.
 
• Carbon dioxide (CO2) is indeed removed from the blood into the lungs and is then exhaled out of the body.
 
• The thoracic region refers to the part of the body where the ribs are located, and it primarily houses the heart and lungs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kidneys**

 
 
• The kidneys are a pair of bean-shaped organs located in the back of the abdominal cavity, one on each side of the spine.
 
• They perform the crucial function of filtering waste products from the blood and excreting them in the form of urine.
 
• They also regulate electrolyte balance and blood pressure and produce hormones that are vital for bodily functions.
 
 
 
• **Urinary Bladder**
 
 
• The urinary bladder is a muscular sac in the pelvis that stores urine until it is ready to be expelled from the body.
 
• The bladder can hold between 300-500 ml of urine in a healthy adult.
 
 
 
• **Exhalation of CO2**
 
 
• Carbon dioxide, a waste product of cellular respiration, is transported in the blood to the lungs.
 
• In the lungs, CO2 diffuses from the blood into the alveoli and is exhaled during the process of breathing out.
 
 
 
• **Thoracic Region**
 
 
• The thoracic region of the body is the part that lies between the neck and the abdomen, housing organs such as the heart and lungs.
 
• This region is protected by the rib cage and thoracic spine.
